title: AI Agent Overview
description: Token usage of the AI agents reporting to this OAP: a day-by-day grid of the last 30 days and an hour-by-hour grid of the last 10, then how many agents there are, what they used over the picked time range, and the twenty busiest of them.

widgets.title: Daily tokens
widgets.tip: Tokens per day over the last 30 days, the busiest agents summed (the footer says when the layer has more than one read covers). A fixed window that does not follow the time picker; click a cell to read its day and value in the footer.

widgets.title: Hourly tokens
widgets.tip: Tokens per hour over the last 10 days, the busiest agents summed: one row per day, one column per hour of the OAP's clock. A fixed window that does not follow the time picker; click a cell to read its hour and value in the footer.

widgets.title: Agents
widgets.tip: Agents reporting on the AI_AGENT layer, and their tokens over the picked range, the twenty busiest agents summed: the total, then by type (input, output, read from cache, written to cache) and the part spent by subagents; cache read share is their average. The list beside it names the agents.

widgets.title: Top 20 agents
widgets.tip: The twenty agents with the most tokens over the picked range, busiest first, each with its total and a bar against the top one. They add up to the tile beside it while the layer has twenty agents or fewer.
